DESCRIPTION: FIND: `_FINDING_ID_RE` uses `r"\bC\d{4}\b"`, matching only 4-digit canonical IDs (C0001) but silently missing model-generated finding IDs (e.g., F001). 
FOLLOW: `_extract_finding_ids()` misses local finding IDs in payloads. Consequently, `er.finding_ids` omits them, leading `EvidenceStore.query(finding_id="F001")`, `trace_finding("F001")`, and `export_bundle(finding_id="F001")` to return empty results for valid model findings. This replaces the overbroad `[A-Za-z]` proposal in C0137 with a strict Canonical/Finding prefix check.
PROPOSED_FIX: FIX

====
